results.name: Deck picker lists the playable reference decks on a phone
Starting a game asks who goes first, then shows the opening hand to keep
The hand is a horizontal strip that scrolls with a real touch swipe
Only hand cards with a legal action are highlighted, and a tap shows the card with its actions
A whole game is played from the touch interface until a result is shown, with a refresh in the middle
A second whole game with the red deck reaches its result; its Life [Trigger] window is answered from the screen
Every /api/play response is no-store and carries no engine state, seed or PRNG
A second game is conceded from the menu and shows a defeat
Anonymous and foreign requests are refused
Collection, decks and coins of the player were not written by playing
